summary: MariaDB is configured on node1 and verified after a full node restart.
actions_performed: Installed MariaDB 12.3.3, initialized its data directory, and enabled mariadb.service.
Created the inventory database and InnoDB items table.
Created inventory_app@localhost with SELECT, INSERT, UPDATE, and DELETE privileges.
Generated the password on node1 and stored connection settings in /etc/inventory-db.env.
Set the credential file to root:root mode 0600 and verified an unprivileged user cannot read it.
Safely restarted node1 and verified MariaDB, the schema, account, credentials, and application access recovered.

evidence.summary: Shows successful creation, active/enabled service, inventory.items schema, and successful application transactions before and after restart.
Confirms inventory_app@localhost, its four DML grants, and authenticated access to inventory.
Confirms node-side credential generation, root:root ownership, mode 0600, no additional ACL access, populated settings, and denied unprivileged readability.
Captures the healthy baseline, safe-reboot acknowledgement, changed boot identity, and complete post-restart service/data/account recovery.
